templates.title: Talking pet
templates.prompt: Locked-off medium shot in a bright, cozy living room. {subject} sits on a light grey sofa and talks straight to the camera in a clear, friendly voice: "{line}". Soft window light, shallow depth of field, natural fur detail, cinematic. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Street vlog
templates.prompt: Handheld vlog-style tracking shot. {subject} walks through {place}, turns to the camera and says: "{line}". Morning light, ambient city sound, cinematic, shallow depth of field. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Desk explainer
templates.prompt: {subject} sits at a tidy study desk with colourful books, a desk lamp and a globe, and explains to the camera: "{line}". Gentle push-in, warm pastel light, 3D animated film look. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Mascot intro
templates.prompt: Use the reference image as the exact character; do not redesign it. The character stands in {place}, waves one paw and says cheerfully: "{line}". Smooth push-in, soft light, high quality 3D animation. No on-screen text.

templates.title: App on a phone
templates.prompt: Locked-off shot, no camera movement. {subject} sits next to a smartphone on a small stand; the phone screen is filled with flat solid chroma-key green with no reflections. {subject} taps the phone, then says to the camera: "{line}". Bright interior, cinematic. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Logo reveal
templates.prompt: Starting from the provided image, the logo assembles from glowing particles on a dark gradient background, settles with a soft light sweep and a subtle whoosh sound. Elegant, minimal, cinematic.

templates.title: Product orbit
templates.prompt: Slow 180-degree orbit around {subject} on a clean pedestal, soft studio light, gentle reflections, quiet ambient music. Premium commercial look. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Noir
templates.prompt: Black-and-white film noir. {subject} in {place} at night, rain on the street, a neon sign glowing, slow dolly-in, low-key light, saxophone in the distance, a narrator says: "{line}".

templates.title: Storybook
templates.prompt: Watercolour storybook illustration that comes to life: {subject} in {place}, pages gently turning at the edges, soft camera drift, a warm narrator says: "{line}".

templates.title: Tiny world
templates.prompt: A tiny-planet, tilt-shift view of {place}; the camera slowly spins and descends toward {subject}. Miniature look, bright colours, playful music. No on-screen text.

templates.title: 8-bit
templates.prompt: Retro 8-bit pixel-art side-scroller: {subject} runs and jumps through {place}, collecting coins, chiptune music and coin sounds. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Plush world
templates.prompt: Everything is made of soft felt and knitted wool: {subject} in {place}, stop-motion feel, gentle camera move, cosy music. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Birthday
templates.prompt: Shiny foil balloons spelling the name {name} float up in a bright room, confetti falls, {subject} pops out and cheers: "{line}". Joyful, cinematic, party sounds.

templates.title: Pop-up card
templates.prompt: A paper greeting card on a wooden table opens and a 3D paper pop-up scene of {subject} unfolds, paper flowers bloom, soft paper sounds and a music-box tune. No on-screen text.

templates.title: Party invite
templates.prompt: {subject} holds an envelope on a cosy table, opens it toward the camera and says: "{line}". Warm light, gentle push-in, soft music. No on-screen text.
